title: Leviticus Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Leviticus 8: the washing, clothing and anointing of Aaron and his sons and the seven days of their consecration.

questions.text: Where was the whole congregation assembled for the consecration of Aaron and his sons?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to assemble the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and Moses did so.

answers.text: By the river outside the camp
At the door of the Tent of Meeting

questions.text: What did Moses put in the breastplate on Aaron?
questions.explanation: Moses placed the breastplate on Aaron and put the Urim and Thummim in it.

questions.text: What did Moses set on the front of Aaron's turban?
questions.explanation: He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

answers.text: A ring of silver set with stones
The golden plate, the holy crown
A blue onyx stone with names
A band of scarlet and purple thread

questions.text: What did Moses pour on Aaron's head to sanctify him?
questions.explanation: Moses poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron's head and anointed him, to sanctify him.

questions.text: What did Aaron and his sons do with the bull of the sin offering before it was killed?
questions.explanation: Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

answers.text: They washed its legs in water
They laid their hands on its head
They led it around the altar
They tied it to the horns of the altar

questions.text: Where were the bull's skin, meat and dung burned?
questions.explanation: The bull, its skin, its meat and its dung were burned with fire outside the camp, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

answers.text: In the courtyard of the tabernacle

questions.text: Where did Moses put some of the blood of the ram of consecration on Aaron?
questions.explanation: Moses put the blood on the tip of Aaron's right ear, the thumb of his right hand and the great toe of his right foot.

answers.text: On his right ear, right thumb and right great toe
On his forehead and on both of his hands
On his left ear, left thumb and left great toe
On his chest and on both of his shoulders

questions.text: Whose portion was the breast of the ram of consecration?
questions.explanation: Moses waved the breast for a wave offering, and it was Moses' portion of the ram of consecration.

questions.text: What were Aaron and his sons to do with the meat and bread that remained?
questions.explanation: Moses said that what remained of the meat and of the bread they should burn with fire.

answers.text: Keep it for the next day

questions.text: For how long were Aaron and his sons not to go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: They were to stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days, until the days of their consecration were fulfilled.
